title: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu flags off Tiranga Rally under Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign 2026
body_text:
The Ministry of Civil Aviation organised a Tiranga Rally today as part of the Independence Day celebrations under the Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign 2026. Union Minister of Civil Aviation, Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, flagged off the rally in the presence of Minister of State for Civil Aviation, Shri Murlidhar Mohol; Secretary, Ministry of Civil Aviation, Shri Samir Kumar Sinha and officers and staff of the Ministry.
The celebrations commenced with the inauguration of a Digital Video Wall by Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu and Shri Murlidhar Mohol, followed by the rendition of “Vande Mataram ” by the dignitaries and participants.
The Tiranga Rally was thereafter flagged off by Union Minister of Civil Aviation Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu. Officers and staff of the Ministry, its Attached and Subordinate Offices, Public Sector Undertakings and Autonomous Bodies joined the procession, carrying the National Flag.
The rally proceeded from Udaan Bhawan to Aviation Park at Rajiv Gandhi Bhawan , with Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Shri Murlidhar Mohol and Shri Samir Kumar Sinha leading the participating contingent. The rally witnessed enthusiastic participation from officers and staff, who joined the celebrations with the Tricolour, reflecting the spirit of unity and national pride associated with the Independence Day celebrations.
The rally culminated at Aviation Park with the rendition of the National Anthem, marking the conclusion of the programme.
The Tiranga Rally was organised as part of the Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign 2026, which encourages citizens to celebrate Independence Day by proudly displaying and engaging with the National Flag, reinforcing the values of national unity and pride .
The event was also attended by Chairman, AAI Shri Vipin Kumar; DG, DGCA Shri Vir Vikram Yadav; DG, AAIB Shri G V G Yugandhar; DG, BCAS Shri Rajesh Nirwan and Chairperson, AERA Shri S K G Rahate, along with other senior officials of the Ministry of Civil Aviation.
*****
Divyanshu Kumar

enrichment.summary: On 13 August 2026, Union Minister of Civil Aviation Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu flagged off a Tiranga Rally at the Ministry of Civil Aviation as part of the nationwide Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign 2026, ahead of Independence Day. The event, also attended by MoS Murlidhar Mohol, Secretary Samir Kumar Sinha, and heads of aviation bodies like AAI, DGCA, AAIB, BCAS and AERA, included inauguration of a digital video wall, rendition of Vande Mataram, a march from Udaan Bhawan to Aviation Park, and concluded with the National Anthem.
enrichment.context: The Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign, launched in 2022 under the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav framework, encourages citizens to hoist or display the National Flag at their homes to foster a sense of patriotism and personal connection with the Tricolour. It is coordinated by the Ministry of Culture and has since become an annual feature of Independence Day observances across government ministries, PSUs, and educational institutions. Events like this Tiranga Rally are largely ceremonial, aimed at mobilising public participation and symbolic national pride rather than announcing any policy or governance measure.
